description: Global Solar Atlas Application is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Extractive industries, Solar", published or maintained by World Bank Group. The World Bank and the International Finance Corporation, collectively The World Bank Group, have provided this Global Solar Atlas in addition to a series of global, regional and country GIS data layers and poster maps, to support the scale-up of solar power in our client countries. Coverage: 31 countries. It has 1 file in HTML. The portal files it under Extractive industries, Solar. The portal gives 2020 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
